_evidence: Second record array of the texture manager (texmgr_00451540 +0x28), 0x54 bytes each (0x45137d..0x45138a: idx*7*3*4 = idx*0x54; 0x44965c..0x449671 index [[0x9fb348]+0x28] the same way). 0x45138f..0x451396 reads the first dword, decrements it when nonzero, 0x45139b compares it with 0 again (reference count: when it reaches 0 the index goes to mgr+0x34). Eight records for indices 0..7; the counter takes 0..3 so the zero skip, the decrement to zero and the decrement to nonzero all occur. Other bytes are random.
